ann.title: Week 8
ann.body:
Dear Students of L09 and L10,
1. Please download from BB the following two files:
(i) Week 8 teaching scope and assignments
(ii) The solutions to the midterm exam of 2022
2. Please take note carefully of the following instructions in advance about the coming midterm exam 2023.
(i). No books, no notes, no dictionaries, no calculators, and most importantly, no hand-phones are allowed in the examination hall.  
(ii). The maximum possible score of this examination is 110.
(iii). There are 13 questions (with parts), which are worth 120 points in total. This means that you do not have to answer all the questions in order to get the full score.
Wishing you all the best on the coming midterm exam,
course staff

ann.title: More Supporting Resources for Calculus
ann.body:
The Minerva College (厚含书院) just opened up the Minerva Academic Support Salon: Mathematics Session. In these sessions, there will be senior undergraduate tutors who major in mathematics to help our students learn calculus by answering their questions. The time of these sessions will be from 7 to 9 on Tuesday and Wednesday, and you will need to book an appointment via the code below in order to use this service (you can see the location once you scan the code).
For more details, please see [course link]
Please note that the calculus help session offered by the Minerva College every Tuesday and Wednesday evening is open to ALL university students (regardless of the school/college you belong to), but you must book an appointment using the code below before going (the location can be seen after scanning the code).
